summary: The note describes The Rehabilitation Center at Hollywood Hills, a private nursing home in Hollywood, Florida, with 152 beds. It was owned by Jack Michel, was affiliated with Larkin Community Hospital, and was acquired by Hollywood Property Investments in 2015.
one_line: A 152-bed private nursing home in Hollywood, Florida, owned by Jack Michel and later acquired by Hollywood Property Investments in 2015.
